name: Kingdom of France

flag.description: A white field strewn with gold fleurs-de-lis, with the royal arms in the centre: a blue shield with three gold fleurs-de-lis under the royal crown, held by two angels and encircled by the collars of the Orders of Saint Michael and the Holy Spirit.
flag.symbolism: White was the colour of the French monarchy, and three gold fleurs-de-lis on blue had been the arms of the kings of France since the Middle Ages.

hook: Royal France is a white flag sprinkled with gold lilies around a crowned blue shield held up by two angels; the Revolution swapped it for the blue-white-red tricolour.
trivia: The Order of the Holy Spirit, whose collar hangs around the shield, was founded by Henry III in 1578 and was the highest order of chivalry in the French monarchy.
A royal restoration in 1873 failed partly because the Count of Chambord, the Bourbon claimant, refused to give up the white flag for the tricolour.
